member.name: T:MindAttic.Authentication.Web.IMaClaimsAugmentor
member.summary: App-implemented hook to bake EXTRA claims into the auth cookie at sign-in (resolved zero-or-many via GetServices). Runs once, just before SignInAsync, so the claims live for the cookie's lifetime. Because claims are NOT rebuilt on revalidation, an augmentor MUST be deterministic from the identity's existing claims (role, amr, uid) — e.g. Ideas adds AuthorRawMarkup iff the identity is an Admin with amr=mfa. Resolve scoped services from the supplied provider if needed.

member.summary: Revalidates the Blazor Server circuit's principal every (default 1 min): reloads the user and rejects if the account is gone/inactive, the SecurityStamp changed (password/role/MFA/global-logout), or the session was revoked/expired — so a revoked admin loses a live circuit within ≤ the interval.
